external_coverage.exact_statement: BEGZ, arXiv:0812.3674v2, §1.2, Definitions 1.1/1.2 and Propositions 1.4/1.6: On a complex n-manifold, for 1≤p≤n and local psh potentials u_j, the locally finite nonpluripolar product is determined by the increasing currents 1_{∩j{u_j>−N}}∧j ddᶜmax(u_j,−N), depends only on the currents, is plurifine-local and charges no pluripolar set. If all potentials are locally bounded outside a closed locally complete pluripolar set A, it is well-defined exactly when the complement Bedford–Taylor product has locally finite mass near A; it is then its trivial extension. Products of closed positive (1,1)-currents on compact Kähler manifolds are well-defined.

DDL, arXiv:1705.05796v3, Theorem 2.4: On a compact Kähler n-fold, for smooth closed real (1,1)-forms θ_j with pseudoeffective classes, u_j,v_j∈PSH(X,θ_j) and v_j≤u_j+C_j imply ∫_X⟨∧j(θ_j+ddᶜu_j)⟩≥∫_X⟨∧j(θ_j+ddᶜv_j)⟩, without a small-unbounded-locus hypothesis.

DDL, arXiv:1705.05796v3, Theorem 2.3: On a compact Kähler n-fold, for smooth closed real (1,1)-forms θ_j with big classes and θ_j-psh sequences u_{j,k}→u_j in capacity, liminf_k∫_Xχ⟨∧j(θ_j+ddᶜu_{j,k})⟩≥∫_Xχ⟨∧j(θ_j+ddᶜu_j)⟩ for bounded positive quasi-continuous χ. If limiting total mass dominates the limsup of approximating masses, the product measures converge weakly.

DDL, arXiv:1705.05796v3, §3.2 and Theorem 3.12: For smooth closed real big-class θ on a compact Kähler n-fold and φ∈PSH(X,θ) with φ≤0 and Mθ(φ)>0, the zero-obstacle singularity envelope satisfies φ≤Pθ[φ]≤0, Mθ(Pθ[φ])=Mθ(φ), Pθ[Pθ[φ]]=Pθ[φ], and is the maximum of {v∈PSH(X,θ):φ≤v≤0, Mθ(v)=Mθ(φ)}, where Mθ(v)=∫_X⟨(θ+ddᶜv)^n⟩.

defect: Proposition5.4 generalized total-variation-to-L1 continuity omits the primitive coordinates a and kappa. The same zero measure and alternating kappa=0,-1 violate L1 convergence in the same big non-nef class. Fixed-state approximation is valid; entire manuscript not accepted.
proposed_repair_not_accepted: Specify a_j->a and kappa_j->kappa together with total variation nu_j->nu on common compact affine support, or hold those primitive coordinates fixed. Include full estimate with |a_j-a| norm(e composed p) and |kappa_j-kappa| volume. Reverify entire amended manuscript independently.
verified_partial_findings: Prescribed-fibration admissible polar-measure sector; positive currents; bigness/non-nefness; genuine ideals and first/top products on every given smooth modification; fixed-state approximation; Cantor full-tower equal-ideal/product/mass but distinct P-ceiling example; stationary rational B model and raw2bc delta_generic within exact trivial-field grant domain. These findings do not confer a whole-manuscript PASS.
